author: Jason Stys
summary: Review relay-local delay, drop, unobserved and ambiguous packet correlation with exact evidence boundaries.
rationale: Helps diagnose simulated transport faults without claiming receiver acknowledgement or loss from incomplete observations.
limitations: A relay send is not receiver acknowledgement or end-to-end delivery proof.
Missing correlation metadata does not prove loss; imported retention and identity declarations remain self-reported.
The ledger does not verify CRC, signature, payload authenticity or operational aircraft safety.
Source-first project with current package/service validation; no public native desktop application release is supplied.

visualReview.method: Every rendered page individually viewed at readable original resolution

scope: Reviewed documentation editions of the cited source. Checksums identify bytes, not authorship. Historical measurements retain their own dates; integration CI must be checked separately.
